cast.name: Everyman
cast.role: the listener's stand-in: the 3 a.m. insomniac, the coffee-shop worrier, the person who stops stirring the mud
cast.look: a tired adult in their early thirties with medium-length dark hair, wearing a grey hoodie and jeans, modern day

cast.name: The Karate Sensei
cast.role: the master martial artist who slips the punch with no mind (mushin)
cast.look: a lean middle-aged Japanese karate master with a short grey crew cut, wearing a white gi with a black belt

cast.name: The Samurai
cast.role: the enraged warrior in the Zen parable of heaven and hell
cast.look: a broad battle-hardened samurai with a topknot and a thick moustache, wearing a dark indigo kimono and armour, feudal Japan

cast.name: The Zen Master
cast.role: the tiny calm master who says 'open the gates of hell'
cast.look: a small elderly bald Zen master with a gentle smile, wearing a saffron-and-brown monk's robe, feudal Japan

cast.name: The Trauma Surgeon
cast.role: uses analytical thinking as a tool in the OR, then ruminates at the dinner table
cast.look: a woman in her forties with hair tied back under a surgical cap, wearing teal scrubs and a mask pushed down, modern hospital

cast.name: The Baby
cast.role: the ultimate non-thinker, absorbed in the texture of a blanket
cast.look: a chubby baby with wisps of light hair in a pale yellow onesie, wide curious eyes
